_comment: BOM-specific config. Universal conventions (refdes letter codes, power-symbol filter, missing-value sentinels) live in conventions.json. No tier-scaling needed for BOM — part data is fixed regardless of circuit size.

property_aliases._comment: Different teams name fields differently. First match wins; lookup is case-insensitive.

text_table._comment: Display widths for printable BOM. CSV/JSON exports never truncate.

csv_columns._comment: Column order and header labels for CSV export.

backfill._comment: Controls bom_backfill.py behaviour. All previously hardcoded defaults are here.
backfill._hidden_comment: New properties appended by backfill are hidden on the canvas (invisible in eeschema) but visible in the KiCad properties dialog and BOM CSV. Set false to make them visible — useful for quick schematic reviews.
backfill._overwrite_comment: When false (default), backfill only fills blank/sentinel fields and never clobbers the user's explicit value. Set true to always refresh from lib + bomdoc.
